name: Endless Tricky Spells
body:
You are able to conceal nearly all of your spellcasting.

Prerequisite(s): Tricky spells class feature, Extra Tricky Spells, Stealth 15 ranks

Benefit: You can use your tricky spells class feature a number of times per day equal to twice your arcane trickster class level instead of the normal amount.
